subject: MAP + evaluation gating: sequencing MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: maria.rossi@heliomed.com, procurement@heliomed.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + evaluation gating — sequencing MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Hi Maria / HelioMed procurement team,

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet you. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass MAP that aligns onboarding milestones, the evaluation plan (pilot gates), and the contract sequencing we typically see: MSA -> DPA -> Order Form (purchase + billing). The objective here is to make the dependency chain explicit so procurement and legal can parallelize where possible and avoid a hard stop at the DPA stage.

Key asks from our side to keep the timeline tight:
- Confirm HelioMed's minimum security evidence (SOC2 + data retention SLA) target dates so we can map to the DPA review window.
- Identify who on your legal team will own redlines for the MSA vs DPA (we recommend separate tracks).
- Tell us which internal milestone (pilot completion or sign-off) triggers billing in your procurement process — we can align order form terms accordingly.

I've attached:
- HelioMed_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners)
- HelioMed_Security_QA.pdf (our standard SOC 2 evidence checklist)
- Draft_OrderForm_Redwood.pdf (blank order form with placeholders)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You confirm the legal owners and any mandatory clause flags by EOD Wednesday (11 Aug).
2) We run a short intake call with both legal teams to pin DPA scope on Thursday.
3) Parallelize MSA redline review (internal legal) while procurement finalizes payment terms.

If that sequencing works, I'll sync with Laura and Aditya on the internal MAP owners and push an updated timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jonas,

Thanks for the summary and attachments — looks thorough. A couple of clarifications from our side before committing owners: 

- Legal will own MSA redlines; HelioMed privacy/legal will own the DPA review. I can loop in our GC (cc'd: legal@heliomed.com) to this thread.
- For pilot billing: our standard is that we execute an order form to enable payment processing once both MSA and DPA are provisionally agreed (we can accept provisional DPA language with SOC2-to-follow if Redwood can commit to the evidence delivery date).
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II or an in-progress remediation plan with clear dates. Can Redwood commit to delivering the SOC2 evidence by the end of month following pilot completion?

We can do the intake call Thursday at 10:00am ET. Please send a calendar invite.
